name: SBL Infratech Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2015, SBL Infratech Ltd is in the business of real estate development.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SBLIL is in the business of construction, development of residential, commercial,
 retail properties, and Project Management. It has executed multiple residential housing 
and commercial building projects, especially in 
Rajasthan (Neemrana).

pros: Stock is trading at 0.82 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -17.6%
Company has a low return on equity of -2.45% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 162 days.
